greeting: A calm Sunday, Dan. The only thing on the calendar was the 9 o'clock board review with Mike, and it's behind you. The girls are with Jen this week, so the rest of the day is yours.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: The p1 item on the Mike + Dan board, overdue since Sept 14. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and sells out; a refundable hold now removes the risk and costs nothing.

needsAttention.title: December break destination
needsAttention.detail: Decide and book the three-week trip for all four girls by Oct 15 — holiday inventory for six is the thinnest of the year. Default to a domestic shortlist unless someone wants international.

needsAttention.title: Give Eugenia a date
needsAttention.detail: She's back Oct 31 and flexible, and asked you to name a date and slot so she can put it in the calendar. You'd floated meeting around ICGN in Toronto.

needsAttention.title: Lock Friday lunch with Fran
needsAttention.detail: You offered Miyake or Isa Bistro for Fri at 12:30; she's fine with sushi as long as there's a cooked option. It just needs your pick and a reservation.

schedule.title: Sunday review with Mike
schedule.detail: 15-minute board sweep — owners and dates on everything, kill what's slipped three Sundays.

flagged.title: Deloitte partner wants to connect
flagged.detail: Gek Choo, an Audit & Assurance Partner at Deloitte, sent a LinkedIn invitation that's awaiting your response.

inbox.noise: Otherwise it's newsletters and retail — NYT Cooking, the WSJ tech brief, a Kayak Toronto hotel nudge, and a run of home-goods sales.

recipe.title: Butternut squash & candied bacon on fresh pasta
recipe.why: Autumn squash is at its sweetest now, and a little candied bacon makes the most of the cool-weather larder.

tasks.title: Get 3 term life quotes for Mike
Portland house order — bedframe + outdoor shower soap holder
Drive the Pathfinder down to St Pete

acts.line: The 15-minute Sunday board review with Mike at 9 was the morning's only fixture.
Nothing on the calendar after 9 — the afternoon is entirely open.
The girls are with Jen this week, so the evening is quiet and yours.
